 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana

entities.text: Syed Saifuddin Quadri vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners/accused No.1 and 3 seeking to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.240 of 2024 on the file of Kachiguda Police Station, Hyderabad, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 352, 384, 385, 420, 468, 471, 441, 447, 383, 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard Sri Syed Ahmed Ali, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri D.Arun Kumar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3.

Without going into the merits of the case, since the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioners is less than seven (07) years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioners to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 30.07.2024 between 11:00 a.m. and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioners shall submit their defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
